stem:
Read the following sentence from paragraph 14.

Your room could double for the city dump.

The author’s purpose in including this statement is to —

options.label: A
options.text: provide an example of unconstructive criticism

options.label: B
options.text: indicate how harsh parents can be

options.label: C
options.text: show that his mother was as critical as his brother

options.label: D
options.text: demonstrate the importance of clear, direct statements

visual_elements: Your room could double for the city dump.
